statement: A record published to more than one public surface has as many chances to go stale as it has surfaces, and the one no pipeline regenerates is the one strangers read. A withdrawal is a claim about a specific artifact, so it must travel with every copy of that artifact or the uncorrected copies keep making the withdrawn claim. 2026-09-10 cejel: cejel.dev served the 2026-08-25 board (@cejel/cejel@0.4.5, rubric v17) carrying the 2026-08-18 withdrawal record, while the public BargLabs/cejel repo still shipped a 2026-07-27 board (0.2.1, witan-rubric-v18-prospective) with zero occurrences of the word withdraw, linked from README.md:198 as the leaderboard the repo ships, and restating in the next lines the sealed-public-scorer reproducibility sentence that the withdrawal had established as false. The staging step wrote one surface and not the other. Moves when the surfaces are single-sourced or the stale copy is removed.
